package.name: luchs_driver
package.description: ROS 1 driver for Luchs A and Luchs B robot chassis over SocketCAN (Luchs A protocol, LCI, Luchs B VCU interface), built on the same luchs_sdk as the ROS 2 driver: cmd_vel in; odometry, TF, joint states, chassis and safety state, battery state, chassis IMU and diagnostics out.
